meta_description:
shivya on October 6, 2026: "BANGALORE, thank you for making the launch of my new book Rootless and Restless extra special 💚
 
When I first started thinking about my book tour, the first place I imagined doing it was a collaborative creative space that felt like the perfect extension of my values – a female-owned independent bookstore @champacabooks, my favorite plant-based café in the country @copperandcloves, a zero waste organic clothing store that is half my wardrobe @nonasties , and a thrift store that gives a new lease of life to used clothes @lovemetwice_vintageandthrift … and I’m so glad we could make it happen there! 
 
👉🏼 I loved being in conversation with @vasanthihariprakash. When we connected for the first time before the launch, it felt like we had known each other a long time with so much in common. Thank you for bringing your beautiful questions, insights and energy to the evening (and also reading the book in record time 😉).
 
👉🏼 I’m so grateful to the awesome team behind @champacabooks ; thank you for such a stunning curation of books, and for giving space to my work on your shelves!
 
👉🏼 All my gratitude to the @copperandcloves team for staying open late for us, and treating our tastebuds to your delicious, healthy, thoughtfully-sourced culinary creations.

👉🏼 Big thank you @dil.cine.foto.drone for your soulful photography! 
 
👉🏼 And most of all, I’m so grateful to each one of you for joining us that evening, bringing so much warmth, love and curiosity into the room. Thanks for waiting patiently during the long book signing, your thoughtful notes and cards, and all the fleeting conversations 🥹
 
I’m now planning the next leg of my book tour in India from end October to mid December – speaking at literature festivals, book clubs and universities. If you have ideas to host a talk or event on the themes of conscious travel, living with local communities and climate action, please reach out 🌸".
